— OUR STORY —

FROM RETRENCHMENT
TO RESILIENCE.

Founded in 1992 by Mr. Dan Maren, STS Logistics was built on determination, resilience, and a commitment to excellence. After being retrenched, Mr. Maren turned a challenging moment into an opportunity by establishing a transport company focused on reliability, integrity, and outstanding service.

More than three decades later, Mr. Maren remains actively involved in the business, ensuring every delivery meets the high standards that have become synonymous with the STS Logistics name.

Today, our reputation is one of our greatest assets. Every member of the STS Logistics team shares the responsibility of protecting and strengthening the trust our clients place in us every day.
— OUR COMMITMENT —

WE OPERATE WITH INTEGRITY.

✓Delivering reliable, efficient transport solutions at competitive prices.
✓Building long-lasting partnerships through honesty, trust, and exceptional service.
✓Operating with integrity while complying with all applicable laws and industry regulations.
✓Upholding the highest ethical standards in every aspect of our business.
✓Recognizing and rewarding excellence within our team.
✓Investing in the ongoing training and development of our employees.
— CUSTOMER SERVICE EXCELLENCE —

EVERY DELIVERY IS A
PROMISE.

At STS Logistics, customer satisfaction is at the heart of everything we do.

We understand that every delivery represents a promise made to our clients. Our experienced team works closely with customers to provide responsive communication, dependable transport solutions, and competitive pricing that delivers real value.

Our goal isn't simply to move freight—it's to build lasting relationships based on trust, reliability, and consistent performance.

— HEALTH, SAFETY & ENVIRONMENTAL —

SAFETY IS EMBEDDED
IN EVERYTHING.

STS Logistics is committed to maintaining a safe, healthy, and environmentally responsible workplace.

—Full compliance with all legal and industry regulations.
—Company-wide commitment to health, safety, and environmental best practices.
—Daily vehicle and equipment inspections.
—Preventative maintenance programs to ensure fleet reliability and safety.
—Zero tolerance for breaches of customer safety procedures.
—Annual medical assessments for all professional drivers.
—Continuous investment in modern vehicles and environmentally responsible operating practices.
By maintaining the highest standards of safety and compliance, we protect our employees, our customers, the communities we serve, and the environment.
